_comment: Settlement records for the Project Banner starting region. Positions are world-map pixels in a 1600x900 space. 'roads' lists the connections drawn between settlements; travel is not restricted to them, they are a visual/logistical hint.

settlements.name: Greywatch
settlements.description: A walled market town straddling the old north road. Its stone bridge is the only dry crossing of the Greywater for thirty miles, which is why the town has a wall at all.

settlements.name: Brackenford
settlements.description: The largest settlement in the march, built where the bracken gives way to worked fields. Its muster yard supplies most of the crown's levies in the region.

settlements.name: Redmoor
settlements.description: A peat-cutting village on the northern moor. Poor, proud, and a long way from anyone who would defend it.

settlements.name: Thornwood Hollow
settlements.description: A choked ravine in the thorn wood. Charcoal burners work the edges by day; nobody camps here by night.
